namespace=globals()
namespace["seed"]=7
def f(x=1): return seed+x
f.__defaults__=(3,)
class Number(int): pass
class Values(list): pass
class Model:
 __slots__=("value","__dict__")
 def __init__(self,value): self.value=value
 @property
 def doubled(self): return self.value*2
m=Model(Number(f()))
m.extra=Values([m.value])
print(f(),f.__globals__ is namespace,locals() is namespace)
print(type(m.value) is Number,m.doubled,m.extra[0],vars(m)["extra"] is m.extra)
wrapped=staticmethod(f)
print(wrapped.__wrapped__ is f,wrapped.__name__==f.__name__)
exec(compile("class Dynamic(Model): pass\nresult=Dynamic(f()).doubled", "reconciled.py", "exec"),namespace)
print(result,"co_name" in dir(f.__code__),"__slots__" in Model.__dict__)

class Box:
 __slots__=("value",)
 def __init__(self,value): self.value=value
def outer():
 box=Box(7)
 def update():
  nonlocal box
  box.value+=2
  print("updated",box.value)
 return update
f=outer()
cell=f.__closure__[0]
exec(f.__code__,f.__globals__,closure=f.__closure__)
print(cell is f.__closure__[0],cell.cell_contents.value,f.__code__.co_freevars[0])

namespace=globals()
namespace["number"]=7
def first(value=1): return value+number
def second(value=1): return value*number
first.__code__=second.__code__
first.__defaults__=(3,)
namespace["number"]=9
method=staticmethod(first)
print(first(),method.__wrapped__ is first,first.__globals__ is namespace)
print(eval(compile("first(2)","expression.py","eval"),namespace))

class A:
 def value(self): return 7
class B:
 def value(self): return 9
class C(A): pass
class D(C): pass
instance=D()
view=C.__dict__
handle=super(D,instance)
C.__bases__=(B,)
print(handle.value(),instance.value(),C.__bases__[0] is B,"__module__" in view)
print(D.__mro__[2] is B,C in B.__subclasses__())

class Amount(int):
 def __add__(self,other): return 99
class Bag(list):
 __slots__=("label",)
 def __len__(self): return 99
amount=Amount(7)
bag=Bag([amount])
bag.label="values"
namespace={"bag":bag,"amount":amount}
exec("bag.append(amount)",namespace)
print(type(amount) is Amount,amount+1,int.__add__(amount,1))
print(len(bag),list.__len__(bag),bag[0] is bag[1],bag.label)

class Box:
 __slots__=("value",)
 def __init__(self,value): self.value=value
def make():
 box=Box(7)
 yield box.value
 yield box.value
stream=make()
print(next(stream))
frame=stream.gi_frame
proxy=frame.f_locals
namespace={"box":proxy["box"]}
exec("box.value=11",namespace)
print(next(stream),frame.f_code is stream.gi_code,eval("box.value+2",namespace))
stream.close()
print(stream.gi_frame is None,proxy["box"].value)

class P(property): pass
def read(self): return self.value
p=P(read)
p.tag=[7]
q=p.setter(None)
class Model:
 value=9
 field=q
method=classmethod(read)
print(type(q) is P,q.__name__,Model().field,p.tag[0])
print(method.__wrapped__ is read,method.__dict__["__name__"]==read.__name__)

class A:
 __slots__=("value",)
 def read(self): return self.value+1
class B:
 __slots__=("value",)
 def read(self): return self.value+2
instance=A()
instance.value=7
def outer(value):
 def get(): return value
 return get
f=outer(instance)
instance.__class__=B
print(f() is instance,f().read(),B.value.__get__(instance,B),f.__closure__[0].cell_contents is instance)

import operator
namespace={"add":operator.add}
exec("class Total:\n __slots__=('value',)\n def __init__(self,value): self.value=value\n def advance(self,other): self.value=add(self.value,other)\ntotal=Total(7)",namespace)
total=namespace["total"]
total.advance(9)
print(total.value,eval("total.value+1",namespace),namespace["Total"].__dict__["advance"].__globals__ is namespace)
